snippet.title: Goeland: Seagull Adventure - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2531840/Goeland?utm_source=youtube

Take off as a mischievous seagull, in this sandbox-style open-world game!
From playful pranks to selfless deeds, be a feathered troublemaker or a helpful hero.
Explore a vibrant island full of quirky citizens, hidden secrets, and dynamic interactions.
Dig up treasure maps, rescue stranded animals, and investigate a strange pollution threatening the island's future.
Whether you're causing chaos or just soaking in the peaceful vibes, let your wings decide the fate of this charming adventure.

Be a part of the journey by adding Goeland to your wishlist today!


Voiceover credits: Victoria Lynn Carroll
